release_notes:
- Fixed device not recognized when TransportUnlock reports "failed." on enumeration
- Removed noisy "Source not found" console messages on startup when a firmware variant is missing on Z: drive
- Fixed leftover "Fetching version" placeholders in Cloud firmware combo when fewer than 5 versions exist
- Fixed "Connect to Z: drive" message incorrectly replacing scan results when all versions failed to download
- Z: drive connection loss now stops remaining download attempts instead of continuing to fail
